verdict.rationale: Fireflies is a meeting-assistant SaaS, so scheduled recurring workflows are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows only event-driven automation: calendar auto-join, a Rules Engine for meeting access and privacy, and webhooks fired when transcription completes. None of these lets a user define a recurring schedule for jobs or workflows; triggers on meeting events are not a recurring schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
